description: The formula of an atomic pattern \(p\) holds on a tuple precisely when the tuple has pattern \(p\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.QuantifierElimination.Shared.atomicPatternFormula_realize.{u} {o : Bool} {n : ℕ} {M : Type u}
  [(Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.QuantifierElimination.Shared.Lang o).Structure M]
  (p : Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.QuantifierElimination.Atom o n → Bool) (x : Fin n → M) :
  (Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.QuantifierElimination.Shared.atomicPatternFormula p).Realize Empty.elim x ↔
    Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.QuantifierElimination.pattern Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.QuantifierElimination.Shared.relation
        x =
      p
